title: The Quatro.md file in this repository does not follow the QuickStart
description:
The quatro.qmd file in this repository does not follow the QuickStart, https://quickstarts.snowflake.com/guide/analyze_data_with_r_using_posit_workbench_and_snowflake/index.html#0, at all.

The QuickStart guide is using https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/519/heart+failure+clinical+records and the quatro.qmd file is using https://app.snowflake.com/marketplace/listing/GZTSZ290BUX5L/cybersyn-web-traffic-foundation-experimental.
